Question Choices: How many endpoints does a line have?
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: A line continues forever at both ends, so it has zero endpoints.

Question Choices: A line segment goes on forever in both directions. Is this statement True or False?
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: A segment has two endpoints and finite length; it does not extend forever.

Question Choices: Select which of these figures has one dimension: ~~Line | Point | Plane~~
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: A line has length direction only, one dimension. A point has zero and a plane has two.

Question Choices: How many endpoints does a ray have?
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: A ray has one endpoint and continues forever in one direction.

Question Choices: Select. The edges of a square are examples of what geometric figure?: ~~Point | Line | Line-segment | Ray | Angle~~
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: Each edge joins two vertices and stops at both. A point has no length, a line continues both ways, a ray continues one way, and an angle is formed by two rays.
